summary.text: Blake Carpenter is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 81 who has served since January 2015 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He lives in Derby, Kansas, and faces Democrat Kayden Bennett in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Blake Carpenter was born in Norman, Oklahoma, and graduated from Halstead High School in 2009.
He earned a bachelor's degree in business from Wichita State University in 2014.
Carpenter assumed office in the Kansas House on January 12, 2015, succeeding Jim Howell.
